coupons_code_auto_chk.name: coupons_code_auto_chk
coupons_code_auto_chk.value: ("coupons"."is_automatic" AND "coupons"."code" IS NULL) OR (NOT "coupons"."is_automatic" AND "coupons"."code" IS NOT NULL)

payments_subject_chk.name: payments_subject_chk
payments_subject_chk.value:
("payments"."kind" = 'order' AND "payments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."enrollment_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("payments"."kind" = 'enrollment' AND "payments"."enrollment_id" IS NOT NULL AND "payments"."order_id" IS NULL)
